response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software development experience (13+ years) with a strong focus on technical leadership, developer tools, and system design. He has led teams, contributed to open-source projects, and demonstrated expertise in build systems and testing infrastructure. While his people management experience is more implicit (e.g., mentoring, organizing workshops), his technical depth and cross-functional collaboration align well with the Engineering Productivity role.
strengths: Deep technical expertise in developer tools, build systems, and testing infrastructure (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial projects).
Strong leadership in technical domains, including team mentorship, code review, and system architecture (e.g., re:cinq, Optilyz, Dunnhumby).
Proven ability to drive organizational change and improve engineering productivity (e.g., TDD, CI/CD adoption at Altom Consulting).
concerns: Limited explicit people management experience in a formal mid-to-senior management role (only 2 years in team leadership roles).
No direct experience with mobile platform ecosystems, which is a preferred qualification for the role.
Most recent leadership experience (at re:cinq and Optilyz) may not fully align with the scale or scope of the target role.
